title: Private P2P access
description: Connect to a home TCP service from a device running frpc. The connection attempts NAT traversal and can use a relay fallback.
adminRequired: An administrator account is required to manage P2P access.
setupOne: Ask your server administrator to configure the public frps coordinator and enable the P2P provider on PandaHome.
setupTwo: Add the home service below. On the remote device, install a compatible frpc and download its visitor configuration.
setupThree: Run the command below on that device, then connect your app to the local address shown on the service card.
setupLimits: This provides private TCP access, not a public website address. Both devices need to be online. NAT or firewall restrictions can prevent a direct connection.
providerEvidence: A running agent does not confirm that NAT traversal succeeded. The connection path is currently unverified; check the remote frpc logs after connecting.
providerReason: The provider is not ready. Check the P2P server settings and frpc installation on the home server.
failed: Could not complete the request. Please try again.
empty: No private services yet. Add a TCP service to get started.
deleteConfirm: Delete this private service? Existing visitor configurations will stop working.
name: Name
localIpHelp: Use an address reachable from the PandaHome server, for example 127.0.0.1 or a LAN address.
fallbackHelp: If NAT traversal fails, the remote frpc can forward traffic through the public coordinator.
downloadHelp: This file contains an access key. Keep it private and copy it only to a trusted remote device.
visitorAddress: After starting frpc, connect to 127.0.0.1:{port} on the remote device.
rotateConfirm: Replace this service’s access key? Every remote device must download a new visitor configuration.
rotateHelp: Key rotation disconnects configurations using the old key. Download a fresh configuration afterwards.
caHelp: Save frps-ca.crt beside visitor.toml. Run frpc from that directory so it can verify the coordinator.
reason_p2p_not_configured: Configure the public coordinator on the PandaHome server first.
reason_p2p_binary_missing: Install frpc on the PandaHome server and check its configured path.
reason_p2p_process_exited: The home connection process exited. Check the server logs and apply configuration again.
reason_p2p_start_failed: The home connection process could not start. Check the server settings and logs.
reason_p2p_stopped: The home connection process is stopped. Apply configuration to start enabled services.
reason_p2p_awaiting_connection: The agent process is running. The coordinator connection and NAT traversal still need verification from a remote device.
reason_p2p_disabled: Enable a service to start the home connection agent.
reason_p2p_reconcile_failed: Configuration could not be applied. Check the server logs before retrying.
